name: acorn
description: The Energy fleet's database domain-expert. Designs multi-tenant schemas, ships zero-downtime migrations (expand→migrate→contract), writes and TESTS RLS policies as the un-privileged role, plans pgvector RAG + PITR, and operates a database safely as an agent (branch/dev only, rows untrusted). Boundary: schema / migrations / RLS / data-layer ONLY — never app code. Powered by Energy.
author: Energy fleet

mcp_servers.name: acorn
mcp_servers.description: acorn's own MCP server — the 12 database-vertical tools (acorn_schema / acorn_rls_lint / acorn_migration_safe / acorn_vector_plan / …) over stdio. Inspect-style tools default to a read-only-at-role, branch/dev-only connection and treat returned rows as untrusted.

tools.name: acorn_schema
tools.description: THE acceptance command — a one-line product brief → tenancy decision + migrations + RLS policies + typed schema, applied to a fresh ephemeral DB with RLS verified by tests as the un-privileged role.
tools.when_to_use: When you need a production-safe multi-tenant Postgres schema from a brief and want migrations + RLS proven, not just generated.

tools.name: acorn_rls_lint
tools.description: Flag every public.* table without RLS, unwrapped auth.uid(), missing WITH CHECK, recursive-policy risk, and missing predicate index (P1-P9). Deterministic SQL-AST/regex — no LLM.
tools.when_to_use: Before shipping any migration that creates a table, to catch the CVE-2025-48757 class of RLS gaps.

tools.name: acorn_migration_safe
tools.description: Rewrite unsafe DDL into the safe form — NOT VALID+VALIDATE, CONCURRENTLY, injected SET lock_timeout, expand/contract scaffold for renames (the 84M-row/4h12m → 42min/$0 fix).
tools.when_to_use: Before applying any migration with a CHECK/NOT NULL/FK/ALTER TYPE/CREATE INDEX/RENAME/DROP on a non-trivial table.

install_instructions: 1. Install deps + build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build  2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select this directory.  3. The acorn CLI (`acorn --help`), the 12 MCP tools, the 5 skills, the 2 sub-agents (rls-auditor, migration-safety-reviewer), and the DB-safety hooks are now available. Boundary: acorn owns schema/migrations/RLS/data-layer ONLY — not app code.
